# Databricks Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

## Purpose and Scope

This briefing prepares a meeting with Databricks on 17 November 2026. It covers product launches, platform changes, partnerships, deals, and hiring signals from roughly 16 October to 15 November 2026, the 30 days before the current date. It ends with three open questions. Where a fact could not be confirmed from the supplied material, the briefing says so.

## Executive Summary

- **Genie One is being distributed beyond the Databricks workspace.** In November, Databricks added connectors and plugins for ChatGPT, Claude, Grok Bot/Cursor, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Copilot Cowork, Slack, a Chrome new-tab extension, and a Windows desktop app ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Microsoft, 2026, November 11](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Enterprise governance is being built into the AI layer.** Genie Search became generally available with permission-aware indexing, context-based ingress rules now cover partner AI platforms, and AI Function spend now counts toward Unity Gateway budgets ([Databricks, 2026, November 9](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Databricks, 2026, November 10](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Microsoft, 2026, November 1](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Several deadlines fall within days of the meeting.** The Genie One MCP Beta endpoint reaches end of life on 30 November 2026, and a breaking change for variant shredding takes effect on 18 November 2026 ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/whats-coming)).
- **One acquisition was reported** (Row Zero), but the supplied material does not give its date or price.
- **No verifiable executive hires were found** in the supplied material for this window.

## Source Reliability Assessment

Sources were ranked by provenance, date, and independence. Official vendor release notes were weighted highest for product facts. Third-party aggregators were used only for context and flagged accordingly.

| Source | Type | Date Coverage | Reliability | Use in This Briefing |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Databricks on AWS release notes, November 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november) | Official vendor documentation | 6–11 Nov 2026 | High | Primary source for product changes |
| [Databricks on Google Cloud release notes, November 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november) | Official vendor documentation (English content, French-locale URL) | 6–11 Nov 2026 | High | Primary source for product changes |
| [Azure Databricks release notes, November 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) | Official documentation (Microsoft Learn) | 1–11 Nov 2026 | High | Primary source; also the most complete list of November dates |
| [Azure Databricks "What's coming?"](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/whats-coming) | Official forward-looking documentation | Upcoming dates | High | Deadlines and scheduled changes |
| [Databricks Community, October 2026 roundup](https://community.databricks.com/t5/product-platform-updates/what-s-new-in-databricks-october-2026/ba-p/175667) | Vendor community post | October 2026 | Medium | Context on dashboards and Genie |
| [Databricks Community, DAIS 2026 article](https://community.databricks.com/t5/community-articles/dais-2026-the-databricks-announcements-i-think-clients-should/td-p/159914) | Partner-authored commentary | June 2026 | Medium | Strategic framing only |
| [SaaS M&A and VC Deals (Row Zero)](https://www.saasrise.com/deals/databricks-buys-row-zero-and-is-scouting-for-more-startups-to-acquire-0cf62ecf-edbc-447c-934d-7ef5822b8bd5) | Third-party deal tracker | Undated in supplied excerpt | Medium-low | Acquisition claim, unverified in detail |
| [Fundz product launch page](https://app.fundz.net/products/databricks-product-launch-917146) | Third-party sales-intelligence vendor page | November 2026 | Low | Launch summary only; marketing content |

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### Product Launches and the Genie One Expansion

The most significant change is the distribution of Genie One. On 11 November 2026, Databricks released the Databricks Genie plugin for ChatGPT. A ChatGPT admin configures the plugin for the workspace, and each user signs in with a Databricks account ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november)). The same day, a Databricks Genie connector for Claude and a Grok Bot/Cursor plugin were released, both using the Genie One MCP ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Microsoft, 2026, November 11](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

On the Microsoft side, a Public Preview plugin for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat lets users query Azure Databricks data without an @-mention. A second Public Preview plugin covers Microsoft Copilot Cowork and does not require creating an OAuth app or editing a plugin manifest ([Microsoft, 2026, November 11](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). Existing installations of the Beta manifest-based plugin are not migrated automatically ([Microsoft, 2026, November 11](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

Other Genie One channels also launched:

- **Chrome extension (Beta, 10 November):** every new tab opens Genie One ([Databricks, 2026, November 10](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Windows desktop app (Beta, 11 November):** adds Windows to the existing macOS app ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Slack app (GA, 9 November):** users can message the app or mention @Genie in channels and group DMs ([Databricks, 2026, November 9](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

Fundz, a third-party sales-intelligence vendor, describes the launch as "the second-generation Genie, an always-on autonomous AI assistant for enterprise work" and dates it to 11 November 2026 ([Fundz, 2026, November 11](https://app.fundz.net/products/databricks-product-launch-917146)). This is a secondary characterization and should be checked against Databricks' own announcement.

### Genie Search and Knowledge Access

Genie Search became generally available on 9 November 2026. It indexes content from Google Drive, Jira, Confluence, and Workday. Databricks indexes each document's permissions alongside its content, so users only see documents they can already access in the source system ([Databricks, 2026, November 9](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Microsoft, 2026, November 9](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). Genie Search also powers org directories in Genie One, which draw on Workday profiles ([Databricks, 2026, November 9](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

### AI Models, Gateway, and Coding Tools

- **Google Gemini 4 Carbon** is available on Unity Gateway through Foundation Model APIs (10 November). Databricks states that customers are responsible for their own compliance with applicable terms ([Databricks, 2026, November 10](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Microsoft, 2026, November 10](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **ChatGPT subscription support in Unity Gateway** (11 November) lets users bill Codex and ChatGPT desktop use to their own ChatGPT Go, Plus, Pro, or Enterprise subscriptions. Unity Gateway still governs access and usage ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code** is now configurable through `ug configure --agents copilot`, alongside Copilot CLI, with Claude, GPT, and open-source models (11 November) ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **ai_decide (Beta)** now uses a new model that Databricks says answers questions 33% more accurately, with unchanged low latency ([Microsoft, 2026, November 2](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **AI Function tasks for Lakeflow Jobs (Beta)** can run ai_parse_document, ai_extract, and ai_classify without SQL, processing only new or changed inputs ([Microsoft, 2026, November 4](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Publishing Unity Gateway Skills from GitHub (Beta)** uses a GitHub Action to publish skills to Unity Catalog on merges ([Microsoft, 2026, November 4](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

### Governance, Security, and Platform Changes

- **Partner AI platforms in ingress policies (10 November):** context-based ingress policies can now allow traffic from ChatGPT and Claude as partner platforms. Databricks maintains their published IP ranges ([Databricks, 2026, November 10](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Context-based ingress in sovereign regions (4 November):** the feature is now available in Azure Government and Azure China North 3 ([Microsoft, 2026, November 4](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Budget webhooks (Beta, 10 November):** budgets can trigger webhooks when spend thresholds are reached, routing events to incident, ticketing, or automation tools ([Microsoft, 2026, November 10](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Databricks, 2026, November 10](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **AI Functions in Unity Gateway budgets (1 November):** spend from ai_parse_document, ai_extract, and ai_classify now counts toward Unity Gateway budgets on both batch and real-time paths ([Microsoft, 2026, November 1](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Unity Catalog wikis (Beta, 6 November):** data owners can document table meaning, use, and sources, and other viewers can comment and suggest edits ([Microsoft, 2026, November 6](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Databricks, 2026, November 6](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Metastore restore (Public Preview, 6 November):** account admins can restore a deleted metastore by ID within 5 days of deletion ([Microsoft, 2026, November 6](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Okta connector (Beta, 3 November)** in Lakeflow Connect ([Microsoft, 2026, November 3](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Custom Python service policies (Beta, 11 November)** ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Feature Views** are now on by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile (11 November) ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

### Deals and Corporate Activity

Databricks acquired Row Zero, a company founded by former AWS and Tableau engineers. Row Zero's technology enables spreadsheets to handle more than one million live rows in a secure, cloud-native environment. Its last reported round was a $10 million Series A in May 2025 at an estimated $40 million valuation, per PitchBook. Financial terms of the acquisition are private ([SaaS M&A and VC Deals, n.d.](https://www.saasrise.com/deals/databricks-buys-row-zero-and-is-scouting-for-more-startups-to-acquire-0cf62ecf-edbc-447c-934d-7ef5822b8bd5)). The supplied excerpt does not state the announcement date, so it cannot be confirmed that the deal falls within the 30-day window. The source also says Databricks is scouting for more startups, but gives no further detail.

### Hiring

The supplied material contains no verifiable executive or senior hires for this period. The Fundz page refers to hiring signals and lists several names, but these entries are hidden or gated and cannot be confirmed as Databricks appointments ([Fundz, 2026, November 11](https://app.fundz.net/products/databricks-product-launch-917146)). The meeting should not assume any leadership changes without confirmation.

## Time-Sensitive Dates Around the Meeting

| Date | Change | Relevance |

| 15 Nov 2026 (today) | File upload in Genie One and Genie Agents is enabled by default for compliance-profile workspaces, where the compliance standard supports it | Depends on the customer's compliance standard ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/whats-coming)) |
| 17 Nov 2026 | Meeting date | — |
| 18 Nov 2026 | Variant shredding is automatically added to new VARIANT tables on Databricks Runtime 17.3 or above. This is a breaking change for Runtime 15.4 clusters, which cannot read or write those tables ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/whats-coming)) | Upgrade affected clusters to Runtime 16.4 or above first |
| 30 Nov 2026 | Genie One MCP Beta endpoint (`/api/2.0/mcp/genie`) reaches end of life. The date was previously 31 October ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/whats-coming)) | Migrate to the GA `system.ai.genie_one_mcp` in Unity Gateway |
| 1 Dec 2026 or later | Billing begins for private network gateway usage ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/whats-coming)) | Cost planning |
| 1 Feb 2027 | AI Functions that require Runtime 15.4 LTS or above are no longer supported on runtimes below 17.3 LTS in SQL. ai_forecast, ai_top_drivers, vector_search, and the REST API are not affected ([Microsoft, 2026, November 5](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)) | Runtime upgrade planning |

## Context from Earlier in 2026

Some earlier announcements provide context, although they fall outside the 30-day window. In September 2026, Databricks reported GA releases for Spark Declarative Pipelines and metastore-level ABAC policies with explicit DENY rules in Unity Catalog. It also raised Genie Agent limits to 50 data sources per agent (from 30), 200,000 conversations per agent (from 10,000), and 100-page PDF uploads (from 20) ([Databricks Community, 2026, September](https://community.databricks.com/t5/product-platform-updates/what-s-new-in-databricks-september-2026/ba-p/173896)). In October, the company reported that AIBI Dashboards were being positioned as a replacement for Power BI and Tableau, with Genie extending into a co-pilot that builds dashboards and optimizes compute ([Databricks Community, 2026, October](https://community.databricks.com/t5/product-platform-updates/what-s-new-in-databricks-october-2026/ba-p/175667)). A partner's DAIS 2026 commentary summarizes the strategy as "bring context closer to data" and "bring governance closer to AI behavior" ([Databricks Community, 2026, June 19](https://community.databricks.com/t5/community-articles/dais-2026-the-databricks-announcements-i-think-clients-should/td-p/159914)).

## Analytical Assessment

Based on the supplied material, my view is that Databricks' November 2026 strategy is a distribution play. Genie One is no longer mainly a feature inside the Databricks workspace. It is being placed in the tools employees already use: ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Slack, Chrome, and the desktop. The governance features shipped in the same window (permission-aware Genie Search, partner-platform ingress rules, budget webhooks) suggest Databricks expects enterprise buyers to resist broad access unless controls come with it. The strength of this approach is that it meets employees where they work. The risk is that every new access path increases the surface that administrators must govern, and the change-management load falls on customers.

The cost-governance signals are also significant. Bringing AI Function spend into Unity Gateway budgets, adding budget webhooks, and offering bring-your-own ChatGPT subscriptions all point to metered AI usage becoming a visible line item that customers want to control. Customers adopting multiple AI channels will need a clear view of what each channel costs.

The Row Zero acquisition fits the pattern. Row Zero's spreadsheet engine for more than one million live rows is a plausible addition to the AI-spreadsheet and business-user layer. However, the supplied material does not show how Row Zero's product will be integrated, and the deal's timing and terms cannot be verified.

Finally, the deadline cluster in late November (variant shredding on 18 November, MCP endpoint end of life on 30 November) is a practical risk. These are not strategic issues, but they can break production workloads if teams are unprepared.

Limitations: this briefing relies on release notes and secondary aggregators. It does not include pricing, customer metrics, or confirmed executive appointments. The Fundz characterization of the Genie launch and the Row Zero deal details should be verified before being repeated externally.

## Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **Genie One MCP migration:** The Beta endpoint reaches end of life on 30 November 2026. What is Databricks' recommended migration path to `system.ai.genie_one_mcp` for customers who have built integrations on the Beta endpoint, and what support is available for those that cannot migrate in time? ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/whats-coming))
2. **Pricing and budget controls for Genie and AI channels:** With AI Function spend now inside Unity Gateway budgets and Genie reaching ChatGPT, Claude, Slack, and Microsoft 365, how will usage across these channels be metered and attributed, and will budget webhooks cover Genie consumption as well as AI Functions? ([Microsoft, 2026, November 1](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Microsoft, 2026, November 10](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november))
3. **Row Zero integration and roadmap:** What is the announcement date and scope of the Row Zero acquisition, and how will its spreadsheet capabilities be integrated with Genie One, AIBI dashboards, and Unity Catalog governance? ([SaaS M&A and VC Deals, n.d.](https://www.saasrise.com/deals/databricks-buys-row-zero-and-is-scouting-for-more-startups-to-acquire-0cf62ecf-edbc-447c-934d-7ef5822b8bd5))
